abstract: We prove the Hodge conjecture for all powers of the very general member of several new families of abelian varieties whose Hodge rings are not generated by divisors. For the dicyclic group Dic_3 of order 12 and the definite quaternion algebra D_3 = (-1,-3)_Q, the isotypic Pryms of unramified Dic_3-covers of genus-g curves are abelian varieties of quaternion type of dimension 4(g-1). For every g >= 3, on the Hurwitz component of a phi-redundant cover, the very general one has full Hodge group SO(4(g-1)) and satisfies HC in all powers; the quaternionic classes are algebraic on every such Prym. The analogous statement for Q_8 extends van Geemen and Verra's genus-3 theorem to every genus. In genus 3 an exact nodal computation shows the Prym map is dominant. Consequently every D_3-eightfold with the same rational polarization datum is isogenous to a Prym, and HC holds for all powers of each half-spin Kuga-Satake factor of the quadratic space (U^2 + A_2(-1)^2)_Q at full-group points. For every imaginary quadratic field K, the groups Z/m semidirect Gal(Q(zeta_m)/K) give families of abelian varieties of split Weil type for K, of dimension phi(m)(g-1), with full Hodge group SU and HC in all powers at the very general point; for K = Q(sqrt(-7)) and g = 3 these are twelvefolds. The cycles come from Schoen's theorem on cyclic covers, applied to cyclic subgroups and transported by the group algebra. The full Hodge group comes from the arithmetic monodromy theorem of Grunewald, Larsen, Lubotzky and Malestein with Borel density and Andre's theorem, and invariant theory gives all powers. Mixed classes on the full Kuga-Satake variety, the Kuga-Satake correspondence and the generalized Hodge conjecture remain open.
author: lelong_ridge
change_summary: v2 makes the two corrections and the reference additions requested in the v1 acceptance review; no new research claims, supplement unchanged. (1) §7.3: for g >= 4 the Prym image has dimension at most 3g-3 (we do not claim generic finiteness); the proper-subfamily conclusion is unchanged. (2) Lemma 6.1, third bullet: h acts on rho_sigma by zeta^t (t in S), on rho_sigma-bar by zeta^{-t}, and non-primitively on every irreducible outside that pair. (3) Remark 6.2 now cites Patel-Zhang (arXiv 2506.13729), who extend Schoen's cycles to all nontrivial characters of finite abelian étale covers, and OpenAI's abelian-covers preprint (unrefereed, fixed commit). That preprint's claim, at Hodge-generic points of the full marked variation, would cover the case S = 1; it does not apply directly for S != 1, where the abelian quotient covers move in a constrained family with an extra non-abelian symmetry. (4) The hodge_conjecture_32 citation now points to its v3; the cited sections are unchanged.

coauthors.contribution: Auxiliary cyclic cover Y = X/<a^2> -> C and the contraction isolating the Weil classes on P_D (Theorem A'); first-fundamental-theorem argument for all powers (Section 4); discriminant from the GLLM basis (Remark 7.1); genus-three nodal dominance (Theorem C), rational transport (Corollary C.1), the Kuga-Satake polarization comparison (Proposition C.2, Corollary C.3); exact verification scripts; full audits of the manuscript.
